inference_mode.description: Firebase AI Logic mode: prefer_on_device, only_on_device, prefer_in_cloud, or only_in_cloud.

cloud_model.description: Cloud Gemini model id used by inCloudParams when inference does not stay on device. The JS SDK 13 default is gemini-3.5-flash-lite.

defaultValue.value:
You are the narrator for ATLAS Explain, a public educational companion.
Explain the market move in the card. This is not financial advice. Do not recommend buying, selling, holding, sizing a position, or setting a target. Do not say "you should".

Use only figures that appear in the card. If a figure is absent, say it was not provided. Do not invent prices, volumes, dates, or causes.

Classify each headline into exactly one topic id from this taxonomy:
{{TAXONOMY}}

User question:
{{QUESTION}}

Move card JSON:
{{MOVE_CARD}}

{{PRIVATE_CONTEXT}}

Return JSON with these fields:
- summary: at most 120 words, plain language, balanced
- headlineTopics: one object per headline, with headline, topic, and a short note
- buyerReasons: exactly 3 reasons someone might see the decline as an opportunity
- sellerReasons: exactly 3 reasons someone might see further downside or ongoing risk
- whatWouldChange: one short paragraph on evidence that would change either case

Reasons must be grounded in the card. If the card is thin, say what is missing instead of filling the gap with a story.

topic_taxonomy.description: JSON array of {id, label}. Ids must be the fixed taxonomy, and other is required.

on_device_max_headlines.description: Headline count above this forces ONLY_IN_CLOUD and drops private notes.

on_device_max_chars.description: Prompt length above this forces ONLY_IN_CLOUD and drops private notes.

long_document_chars.description: Document length above this is treated as a long document and forced to the cloud.

max_output_tokens.description: maxOutputTokens for the cloud model. Gemini 3.x ignores temperature, so it is not sent.

billing_enabled.description: Kill switch. false keeps the app free: every Pro entitlement is on and checkout is hidden. true meters cloud calls.

free_cloud_daily_limit.description: Cloud explanations per day on the free plan after billing_enabled is true.

price_provider.description: Live crypto prices: coingecko (default: free with attribution, includes coin images) or kraken (demo only: its terms restrict third-party apps).

coingecko_demo_api_key.description: Optional CoinGecko Demo API key used only when price_provider is coingecko. Leave empty for keyless public access. Never commit a key.

logo_dev_token.description: Optional Logo.dev publishable key (pk_...). Turns on company logos on stock pages, with the required 'Logos provided by Logo.dev' credit. Empty: no company logos.
